published_title: Who says WYS has to be all smugglers?
description: A deck I played at a tourney where all decks had to play at least 8 v8 cards.
strategy: This is a very fun deck to play.  You set up Obiwan at Cantina for a first turn drain of three which rocks.  If they come after obiwan and kill him, Houjix him and no big deal.  Drop Luke or a raider on a pt craft to the db and either signal, tunnel vision, or speak for cellebration and throw somebody down on tatooine to cellebrate.  There are lots of little tricks with this deck.  Strangle with leia if they play bounty hunters which was pretty common at the v8 tourney.  Once you get out the other two DBs w/ Insurrection, you can do some serious retrieval with cellebration.  The other thing is to do a few late game kessel runs.  For ground defense, my all time favorite combo if they ambush you at one of the dbs.  Play Fallen Portal then OOS for Lobot v, then Lobot v for Lando.  Though it rarely works more than once per game, it turns an ambush into a masacre.
